evals.prompt: I'd like to fix issue #412 in druxt.js: DruxtMenu renders an empty <ul> when the menu has no items. Get me set up to start on it.
evals.expected_output: Checks the issue, proposes a feature/412-... branch from upstream develop, and plans a failing unit test in packages/menu/test before any code change.
expectations: Proposes a branch named feature/<issue>-<description> created from develop
Plans a failing unit test in packages/menu/test before changing source
Does not edit any source file before the branch and test plan exist

evals.prompt: Add a `prefetch` prop to DruxtRouter so links can be prefetched. Start the work on this.
evals.expected_output: Looks for or drafts an issue, branches from develop with the feature/ prefix, and writes a spec with Goal, Acceptance criteria, In scope and Out of scope sections before code.
expectations: Looks for an existing issue or drafts one before writing code
Writes or proposes a spec that has an Out of scope section
Uses the feature/ branch prefix, not feat/
